tests.title: Config declares exactly the fourteen fields in the specified order and types
given: the root package agentkit
tests.when: reflect.TypeOf(agentkit.Config{}) is walked field by field
then: there are exactly 14 fields named Client, Provider, Model, Effort, Env, Getenv, System, Prefix, Toolset, MaxTurns, MaxCostUSD, Timeout, Prune, MaxTokens in that order
Client is core.ProviderClient, Provider and Model are string, Effort is Effort, Env is map[string]string, Getenv is func(string) string
the last eight fields keep their current types
tests.pseudocode: t = TypeOf(Config{}); assert t.NumField()==14; for i,(name,typ) in expected: assert t.Field(i).Name==name && t.Field(i).Type.String()==typ

tests.title: Provider names are trimmed, case-insensitive and empty means anthropic
given: Env supplies an Anthropic key and an OpenRouter key
tests.when: Resolve is called with Provider " OpenRouter ", "ANTHROPIC", "" and "Ollama"
then: Resolution.Provider is "openrouter", "anthropic", "anthropic" and "ollama" respectively
tests.pseudocode: for in,want in cases: r,err = Resolve(Config{Provider:in, Model:'STANDARD', Env:keys}); assert err==nil && r.Provider==want

tests.title: Variable lookup order is Env, then Getenv, then process environment, empty counts as unset
given: the process environment holds OPENROUTER_API_KEY=proc
a Getenv that records its calls and returns "k" for OPENROUTER_API_KEY
tests.when: Resolve with Provider openrouter is run with Env {"OPENROUTER_API_KEY": ""}, then with Env {"OPENROUTER_API_KEY":"e"}, then with Getenv unset and Env empty
then: with the empty Env value the provider uses key "k" from Getenv
with a non-empty Env value the provider uses "e" and Getenv is not asked for the key
with Getenv set the process value "proc" is never used, even when Getenv returns empty (Resolve fails with openrouter.ErrNoAPIKey)
with Getenv nil the process value is used
tests.pseudocode: send a request to a recording server and inspect the Authorization header in each case; assert it equals 'Bearer k' / 'Bearer e' / 'Bearer proc'

tests.title: The root package's non-test code imports no anthropic-sdk-go package
given: the repository module
tests.when: go list -f '{{.Imports}}' for the root package is evaluated (non-test imports only)
then: no import path starts with github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go
tests.pseudocode: out = exec('go list -f {{join .Imports "\n"}} .'); for p in lines(out): assert !hasPrefix(p, 'github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go')

tests.title: Resolve returns the catalog selection plus a client for a tier and for a model id
given: credentials for OpenRouter supplied through Getenv
tests.when: Resolve is called with Provider openrouter and Model STANDARD with Effort empty, and again with Model qwen/qwen3.8-flash and Effort "HIGH"
then: the first Resolution has Tier STANDARD, Model.ID qwen/qwen3.8-flash, Effort medium, Listed true, non-nil Client
the second has empty Tier, Effort high (normalized) and Listed true
each field equals the corresponding catalog.Select result
tests.pseudocode: sel,_ = catalog.Select(p,m,e); r,_ = Resolve(cfg); assert r.Provider==sel.Provider && r.Tier==sel.Tier && DeepEqual(r.Model,sel.Model) && r.Effort==sel.Effort && r.Listed==sel.Listed && r.Client!=nil

tests.title: Resolve returns catalog errors unchanged, with or without Config.Client
given: a faux client for the Client-set cases
a Getenv that counts calls
tests.when: Resolve is called with Provider "gemini", with an empty Model, and with Effort "turbo", each with Client nil and with Client set
then: errors.Is matches catalog.ErrUnknownProvider, catalog.ErrNoModel and catalog.ErrUnknownEffort respectively in both variants
the returned Resolution is the zero value
the error message names the rejected value and the valid choices
Getenv was called zero times
tests.pseudocode: r,err = Resolve(cfg); assert errors.Is(err, want); assert r.Client==nil && r.Provider==''; assert contains(err.Error(), badValue); assert calls==0

tests.title: Resolution's selection fields depend only on the six selection fields
given: a hermetic Getenv supplying all credentials
tests.when: for any valid provider, model (tier or id) and effort, and any values of System, Prefix, Toolset, MaxTurns, MaxCostUSD, Timeout, Prune and MaxTokens
then: two Resolve calls return equal Provider, Tier, Model, Effort and Listed
varying the non-selection fields changes none of them
tests.pseudocode: for base,noise in gen(): a=Resolve(base); b=Resolve(withNoise(base,noise)); assert sameSelection(a,b)

tests.title: Resolve sends no request and returns a new client on each call
given: recording servers for all three providers, their base-URL variables pointing at them
tests.when: Resolve is called several times for each provider with the same config
then: every recording server counts zero requests
two calls return distinct Client values (different pointers/instances)
no state from the first call is visible in the second
tests.pseudocode: c1=Resolve(cfg).Client; c2=Resolve(cfg).Client; assert c1 != c2; assert all(s.count==0)

tests.title: Anthropic client is built with Options{Env, Getenv} and resolves per request
given: a recording Anthropic server
Getenv supplying ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=k1 and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the server
tests.when: Resolve is called with Provider anthropic and the Client is streamed once, then Getenv's key is changed to k2 and it is streamed again
then: Resolve succeeds after the credential pre-check
the first request carries k1 and the second carries k2, showing per-request resolution via Env/Getenv rather than a fixed SDK client
tests.pseudocode: r=Resolve(cfg); stream(r.Client); assert server.reqs[0].header['x-api-key']=='k1'; env['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY']='k2'; stream(r.Client); assert reqs[1]==...'k2'

the second returns the zero Resolution and the anthropic.Resolve error naming both ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
the error equals what anthropic.Resolve returns over the same lookup
tests.pseudocode: r,err=Resolve(cfg); assert errors.Is(err, anthropic.ErrNoCredentials); assert r.Client==nil

tests.title: Getenv is asked only for the chosen provider's variables and never for AGENTKIT_ names

tests.title: A run reaches only the chosen provider's recording server

then: the chosen provider's server records at least one request
the other two servers record zero requests
tests.pseudocode: for p: reset(all); New(cfg(p)).Run('hi'); assert count[p]>=1; assert count[q]==0 for q!=p

tests.title: No provider's secret ever appears in a request sent while running on another provider

an Ollama API key set that must never be sent
